title: Answers that point to their sources
text: I've built two assistants that answer from a fixed set of documents and show which passages they used: one for pediatric guidelines, one for Egyptian law. Both are set up to say they don't have the evidence instead of guessing.

title: Search that handles meaning and exact terms
text: Embeddings are good at paraphrased questions and bad at exact thresholds and drug names. Keyword search is the opposite. MedSeek runs both and merges the results.

title: Voice and photos as input
text: In MedSeek, a voice note in Arabic or English is transcribed, and a photo of a rash is described by a vision model. Both then go through the same retrieval pipeline as a typed question.

title: LLM output that code can depend on
text: The AG News service turns articles into validated JSON. It is built around schemas, retries, and a fallback for malformed responses, since an app can't use almost-valid JSON.
